text: 昨天，我学弟二狗哭了。
en: Yesterday, my junior Er Gou cried.

text: 他女朋友过生日管他要了某奢侈品牌的化妆品，他累死累活做了一个月的兼职，再加上当月的生活费，终于凑齐的买化妆品的钱。
en: For his girlfriend's birthday she asked him for cosmetics from a certain luxury brand. He worked himself to the bone with a month of part-time work, plus that month's living expenses, and finally scraped together the money to buy the cosmetics.

text: 吃饭，出去玩，回来的时候二狗的支付宝里还剩下2块5。
en: After eating, going out, and coming back, Er Gou had only 2.5 yuan left in his Alipay account.

text: 好不容易捱过校门，二狗还在想着剩下的20多天，该怎么过？
en: Having barely got past the school gate, Er Gou was still wondering how he would get through the remaining twenty-odd days.

text: 女朋友却看到了街边的水果摊在卖菠萝，死活要吃。
en: But his girlfriend spotted a roadside fruit stall selling pineapples and insisted on having one.

text: 二狗没钱了，女朋友说他抠，甩了他一个巴掌大骂一句渣男潇洒的走了。
en: Er Gou had no money left, so his girlfriend called him stingy, slapped him, shouted 'scumbag' at him, and walked away coolly.

text: 二狗说，他爸妈都没打过他。
en: Er Gou said his parents had never laid a hand on him.

text: 我问他，你怎么不打回去？
en: I asked him, why didn't you hit her back?

text: 他颤颤巍巍的说出了那句，因为我是男人。
en: He said tremblingly, 'Because I am a man.'

text: 听了二狗的话，我突然有种说不出的感觉。
en: Hearing Er Gou's words, I was suddenly overcome with an indescribable feeling.

text: 男人这个词，也许更多的是意味着担当，隐忍，责任。
en: The word 'man' perhaps means more about responsibility, restraint, and duty.

text: 营销号为了阅读量，疯狂带节奏呼吁女权，让男人买买买，为爱付账。
en: For the sake of readership, marketed accounts madly stir things up and call for feminism, urging men to keep buying and foot the bill for love.

text: 逢年过节要转账，要为女朋友的精致买单，在外面辛苦搬砖省吃俭用也只为博红颜一笑而已。
en: On every festival they must transfer money and pay for their girlfriend's refined lifestyle; working hard outside, scrimping and saving, all just to win a smile from the one they love.

text: 他们为女朋友买上百上千的化妆品，而自己还在用大宝；他们情人节为女朋友转了520、1314，然后自己默默的吃了一个月泡面；他们辛苦在外拼搏一天，回来还要继续扮演老公、父亲的角色。
en: They buy their girlfriends cosmetics worth hundreds or thousands, while still using Dabao themselves; on Valentine's Day they transfer 520 or 1314 to their girlfriends, then quietly eat instant noodles for a month; after a hard day's struggle outside, they come home to keep playing the role of husband and father.

text: 女人混的不好，可以有很多退路，可男人混的不好，只会让人瞧不起。
en: If a woman does poorly in life, she has many ways out, but if a man does poorly, he only earns people's contempt.

text: 都说女人过了30岁就贬值了，其实男人走出校门的那一刻就贬值了。
en: It is said that women depreciate after turning thirty, but in truth a man depreciates the moment he steps out of the school gates.

text: 在学校女生会因为你打球很帅，学习很好，或是人很幽默喜欢你，可你走出校门的那一刻，你没钱，你买不起车房，你付不起彩礼，真的就没人喜欢你了。
en: At school, girls may like you because you play basketball well, study hard, or have a great sense of humour; but the moment you step out of the school gates, if you have no money, cannot afford a car or a flat, and cannot pay the bride price, truly no one will like you.

text: 最真实的一面啊，作为一个男生，我很认真的回答一下这个
en: As for the most genuine side of it, as a young man, let me answer this quite seriously.

text: 一、关于真的喜欢一个女孩子
en: I. On truly liking a girl

text: 首先，如果真的喜欢一个女孩子，就会真的忍不住去联系她。
en: First, if you truly like a girl, you really cannot help but contact her.

text: 没有什么高冷的，忽冷忽热的，工作忙的，顾不上的情况。
en: There is no such thing as being aloof, hot and cold, busy with work, or unable to attend to her.

text: 真的喜欢一个女孩子，他一定会想办法和她联系，逗她开心，想办法让她顺心。
en: If he truly likes a girl, he will definitely find ways to contact her, cheer her up, and do what he can to please her.

text: 其次，会变得有点点小自卑。
en: Second, he becomes a little insecure.

text: 就会觉得自己不够好，不管外表多强大，多自信。
en: He feels he is not good enough, no matter how strong or confident he appears on the outside.

text: 内心一定是这么想的，总会担心。
en: Deep down he must be thinking this, always worried.

text: 我给她的会不会不够好呢？
en: Will what I give her not be good enough?

text: 最后，会真的很努力。
en: Finally, he will really strive hard.

text: 想办法让两个人的生活更好。
en: He finds ways to make life better for the two of them.

text: 其实很多男生真的很欠打，很多时候努力的动力，其实就是家庭。
en: Actually, many young men really deserve a beating; much of the time, the motivation to strive is simply the family.

text: 其实家呢，就是她吧。
en: Actually, the family is her, I suppose.

text: 二、关于人品性格
en: II. On character and temperament

text: 看家教一定是一个很不错的方式。
en: Looking at someone's upbringing is surely a very good approach.

text: 父母的职业，为人，处事风格。
en: The parents' occupations, conduct, and style of handling matters.

text: 一定会影响到孩子的方方面面。
en: These will certainly influence every aspect of the child.

text: 不过应该着重看一下，在孩子成长过程中，父母哪一方对孩子影响的更大。
en: Yet one should focus on which parent had the greater influence on the child during their upbringing.

text: 看脾气。
en: Look at their temper.

text: 脾气这个事儿呢，你要说两个人在一起不吵架不闹脾气，这是不实际的。
en: As for temper, to say two people living together never quarrel or lose their temper is unrealistic.

text: 但是，划重点，男人啊真的够成熟，99%的时候，是不会对自己的女朋友/老婆发火的。
en: But, to underline the key point, a truly mature man will, ninety-nine per cent of the time, not lose his temper with his girlfriend or wife.

text: 那些因为爱你而产生的孩子气，是不会表现在脾气上的。
en: That childishness born of loving you will not show in his temper.

text: 包容度，注意他对朋友，对家人的态度。
en: Capacity for tolerance — note his attitude towards friends and family.

text: 其实这就是他日常的太对。
en: Actually, this is his everyday attitude.

text: 这个是装不出来的。
en: This cannot be faked.

text: 全部在细节里面。
en: It is all in the details.

text: 只要你不会被爱情冲昏头脑，基本上是有判断能力的。
en: As long as you are not swept away by love, you basically have the judgement to tell.

text: 其实有一个最重要的东西，容易被忽略。
en: Actually, there is one most important thing that is easily overlooked.

text: 一个男人啊，其实用两个字就可以看出很多东西，那就是“耐心”。
en: A man, in fact, can reveal a great deal through just two words: 'patience'.

text: 看他对各种事情的耐心，看他对你的耐心。
en: Look at his patience with all sorts of matters, and at his patience with you.

text: 往往耐心更好的，会有好脾气，好性格，更好的上进心，以及对你更深的爱。
en: Those with greater patience tend to have a good temper, a good character, stronger ambition, and a deeper love for you.

text: 那种闹一闹，就要分手，过两天又来和好的人。
en: As for those who make a scene, demand a breakup, and then come back to make up a couple of days later —

text: 大家自己把握吧。
en: Everyone should judge for themselves.

text: 其实男生在你面前装这个事吧，说实在的，只要是个男生都在装，无非最大的区别，有些人能装一辈子，装着装着就习惯了。
en: Actually, when it comes to young men putting on an act in front of you, to be honest, every young man is pretending; the only real difference is that some can pretend for a lifetime, and gradually grow accustomed to it.

text: 而有些人呢，装着装着就不愿意装了。
en: While others, after pretending for a while, are no longer willing to keep it up.

text: 以上。
en: The above.

text: 也怕受伤也怕疼。
en: They too fear being hurt and fear pain.

text: 也怕跌倒也怕累。
en: They too fear falling and fear exhaustion.

text: 也怕所爱非人，
en: They too fear loving the wrong person,

text: 也怕痴心错付。
en: They too fear misplacing their devotion.

text: 也怕负担，更怕负担不起。
en: They too fear the burden, and fear even more being unable to bear it.

text: 去看男频文…
en: Go and read male-oriented web fiction…

text: 比较统一存在的元素就是：钱权和性
en: The fairly consistent elements are: money, power, and sex.

text: 反过来看女频是：感情和报复。
en: Looking at the female-oriented side, it is: emotion and revenge.

text: 这样类比你大概就有个概念。
en: With this analogy, you probably get the idea.

text: 1.一个女生要躺赢，一辈子命好，有一个秘诀：精神上不受力。
en: 1. For a girl to win effortlessly and be fortunate all her life, there is one secret: be mentally unaffected.

text: 什么意思呢？
en: What does that mean?

text: 男人无论对你做了什么事说了什么话，发生什么事情，你不太容易难受。
en: No matter what a man does to you, what he says, or what happens, you do not easily feel upset.

text: 什么叫受力呢？
en: What does it mean to be affected?

text: 别人说几句话，你就炸了，这叫做受力。
en: Someone says a few words and you blow up — that is being affected.

text: 一个女生但凡是精神上受力的，都是苦命。
en: Any girl who is mentally affected is destined for a hard life.

text: 精神上越受力的人，越不要拥有优良资产，比如有很多钱，有让别人羡慕的伴侣。
en: The more mentally affected a person is, the less they should possess fine assets, such as a lot of money or an enviable partner.

text: 因为精神上很受力，你拥有了这些东西，一定会被人算计。
en: Because if you are so easily affected, once you possess these things, you are bound to be taken advantage of.

text: 2.永远不要被简单的细节感动的涕泗横流。
en: 2. Never be reduced to tears by simple details.

text: 如果某个男人主动替你拎包，把你放在道路的里边走，主动为你拉椅子，不要因此而感激涕零。
en: If a man offers to carry your bag, walks on the outside so you are on the inner side of the road, or pulls out a chair for you, do not be overwhelmed with gratitude because of it.

text: 这只能说明他之前有无数个女朋友教过他这一点，而能让他记住的女人，永远是改变了他的那个女人，不是你。
en: This only shows that countless girlfriends before you taught him this; the woman he truly remembers is always the one who changed him, not you.

text: 所以，越是细节完美的男人，对女人而言越是挑战。
en: Therefore, the more flawless a man is in the details, the more of a challenge he is for a woman.

text: 3.永远不要说男人渣，即便他真是个渣男。
en: 3. Never call a man a scumbag, even if he truly is one.

text: 对异性的认知，很容易判断出一个人能不能获得幸福。
en: One's view of the opposite sex easily reveals whether a person can find happiness.

text: 那些开口就说女人很物质，以及男人没一个好东西的人，两者都很可怜。
en: Those who blurt out that women are materialistic, and that no man is any good, are both equally pitiful.

text: 一是自己从来没有被生活好好对待过，二是自己接触的人都太糟糕了。
en: First, they have never been treated well by life; second, the people they have met are simply awful.

text: 所以，他渣让他继续渣就好了，你只需要离开他，不能和垃圾待久了，不然，自己也会变成垃圾。
en: So, if he is a scumbag, just let him carry on being one; you only need to leave him. Do not stay with rubbish for too long, or you too will become rubbish.

text: 人生中大多数的糟心，都是由于和烂人烂事纠缠不清导致的，遇到烂人烂事，一定要及时制止，及时抽身。
en: Most of life's misery comes from getting entangled with awful people and sordid affairs; when you meet such people and matters, you must stop it promptly and extract yourself in time.

text: 4.永远不要担心，对方会不会背叛你。
en: 4. Never worry about whether the other person will betray you.

text: 你只需要知道，如果对方真这样做了，你是否能承受。
en: You only need to know whether, if they truly do, you can bear it.

text: 当你被骗或被坑了的时候，请你不要怪这个社会不美好，或者说别人的人品变差了。
en: When you are deceived or cheated, do not blame society for being unkind, or say that others' character has worsened.

text: 实际上，人家从头至尾一点儿都没有变过，人性也未改变，这个社会，也还是原来的那个模样。
en: In truth, they have not changed in the slightest from beginning to end; human nature has not changed either, and society is still just as it was.

text: 只不过你被一些弱势文化，和一些垃圾思想蒙蔽了双眼，混淆了大脑，还让你误以为你所遇到的都是美好的人品以及美好的人间。
en: It is only that you have been blinded by some inferior culture and some rubbish thinking, your mind muddled, so that you mistakenly believe everyone you meet has a fine character and that the world is a wonderful place.

text: 5.永远不要试图找有趣的灵魂。
en: 5. Never try to find an interesting soul.

text: 这个世界上不存在可以说的话上的人，如果有，那也只能是因为有利益关系。
en: There is no one in this world you can truly talk to; if there is, it can only be because of a relationship of interest.

text: 无论是朋友、工作还是恋爱，如果你感到与对方特别契合，沟通愉悦，甚至时时令你灵光乍现，你知道这说明什么吗?
en: Whether in friendship, work, or romance, if you feel especially in tune with the other person, communicate joyfully, and are even struck with inspiration from time to time, do you know what this means?

text: 1%的可能你遇到了知音，99%的可能你遇到了阅历。
en: There is a one per cent chance you have met a kindred spirit, and a ninety-nine per cent chance you have met experience.

text: 智商情商9都在你之上的人。
en: Someone whose intelligence and emotional intelligence are both above yours.

text: 而对方因为什么目的，在向下兼容而已。
en: And the other person, for whatever purpose, is simply meeting you at a lower level.

text: 6.永远不要期待男人会救你。
en: 6. Never expect a man to save you.

text: 7.所有的感情都经不起验证，这是为什么呢？
en: 7. All feelings cannot withstand being tested — why is that?

text: 是因为在一段关系中，种信任的种子，你们会越来越好，种破坏信任的种子，你们会越来越差。
en: It is because in a relationship, if you sow seeds of trust, you will grow better together; if you sow seeds that destroy trust, you will grow worse.

text: 验证感情这个动作，你在感情种植入的是猜忌的种子，怀疑的种子，破坏信任的种子。
en: The act of testing feelings means you are planting in the relationship seeds of suspicion, doubt, and broken trust.

text: 这是对缘分有破坏力的种子。
en: These are seeds that are destructive to the bond between you.

text: 所以验证的心，会让你们的关系走向崩溃。
en: So a heart set on testing will drive your relationship towards collapse.

text: 尤其是那种女生会套男朋友或者老公的话，会逼着老公写保证，通通是把关系逼向对立的状态。
en: Especially when a girl tries to trap her boyfriend or husband into saying things, or forces her husband to write guarantees — all of this pushes the relationship into opposition.

text: 不管什么形式的验证，都是在深埋一颗破坏关系的种子。
en: No matter what form the testing takes, it is deeply burying a seed that destroys the relationship.

text: 这样的种子种的越多，你们的感情就越差，而一念相生，念念相续，有这样念头的女生，在感情中会极其不顺，并且一结婚就倒霉。
en: The more such seeds you sow, the worse your feelings become; and as one thought gives rise to another and thoughts continue in succession, a girl with such thoughts will be extremely unlucky in love, and will come to grief the moment she marries.

text: 8.一个你喜欢的男生，喝醉了，叫你出去找他，你去不去？
en: 8. A boy you like gets drunk and asks you to come out to find him — would you go?

text: 一定要去。
en: Definitely go.

text: 为什么？
en: Why?

text: 现在是他脆弱的时候，也是非常容易建立精神链接的机会。
en: This is when he is vulnerable, and also a chance to build a spiritual connection very easily.

text: 但是这个去，有一件事情特别重要：绝对不会跟他发生关系。
en: But in going, one thing is especially important: absolutely must not have sex with him.

text: 这是一个非常重要的前提。
en: This is a very important premise.

text: 为什么？
en: Why?

text: 只要这个时候，发生关系了，你就是一个呼之即来，挥之既去的女生，你在这个男生心理就jian。
en: If you have sex at this moment, you become a girl who comes at a call and goes at a wave — in that boy's mind, you are cheap.

text: 所以你去，是去建立精神链接。
en: So you go to build a spiritual connection.

text: 但如果你是一个定力不够的人，把持不住，你就别去。
en: But if you are someone without enough self-control, unable to hold yourself back, then do not go.

text: 这是一个需要心力和勇气的做法，没有智慧的女生，看看就可以了。
en: This is a course of action that requires mental strength and courage; a girl without wisdom need only observe.

text: 9.女生要多谈恋爱，找人练手。
en: 9. Girls should date more and find people to practise with.

text: 不要害怕接触不同的男生，只要尊重自己的内心，正常了解，喜欢与否多问问自己就好。
en: Do not be afraid to meet different boys; as long as you respect your own heart, get to know them normally, and ask yourself often whether you like them.

text: 谈恋爱，接触归接触，一定不要跟不喜欢的人滚床单，滚床单做的是爱的事情，没有爱就不要做，不要卖了自己。
en: In dating, contact is contact, but never go to bed with someone you do not like; sleeping together is an act of love — without love, do not do it, do not sell yourself.

text: 为什么要多接触呢? 用来训练自己经营关系的能力，没感觉的男生，试试处成好朋友，那么你的路就会越走越宽。
en: Why meet more people? To train your ability to manage relationships. With boys you feel nothing for, try to become good friends; then your path will grow ever wider.

text: 两人各削去一半自己的个性和缺点，然后凑合在一起才完整。
en: The two of them each cut away half of their own personality and faults, and only by coming together like that are they complete.

text: 如果没有相互的忍让和包容，最终两个人很难成为一体。
en: Without mutual tolerance and acceptance, in the end the two will find it hard to become one.

text: 11.喜欢的人怎么能忘记呢?只要有利益纷争。
en: 11. How can you forget someone you like? Only when interests clash.

text: 在任何情况下，只要利益出现纷争了，一秒钟就可以忘记对方，你俩利益矛盾尖锐时，你一分钟都不会再喜欢他。
en: In any situation, the moment a conflict of interest arises, you can forget the other person in a second; when your interests are sharply opposed, you will not like him for even a minute longer.

text: 比如他断了你的财路，毁了你的信仰，摧垮了你的商业链条，你恨不得杀了他。
en: For instance, if he cuts off your source of income, destroys your beliefs, or collapses your business chain, you would want nothing more than to kill him.

text: 12.感情，最没有分量和力度。
en: 12. Feelings have the least weight and force.

text: 在商业，利益，感情，金钱，价值的关系之中，就属感情的关系最弱。
en: Among the relationships of commerce, interest, feeling, money, and value, the relationship of feeling is the weakest.

text: 如果在你没有了实力，价值和金钱的时候，只剩了一个孤零零的感情，那么，即便你付出全部，掏心掏肺，也不会获得一点好处。
en: If, when you have lost your strength, value, and money, all that remains is a lonely feeling, then even if you give your all and bare your heart, you will gain not the slightest benefit.

text: 因为，在任何一段关系中，动了感情的人，就是把刀柄交给了别人的人，就是等待着被宰割的人，拿起感情这把刀，不仅能收割万千，还能毒死无数。
en: Because in any relationship, the one who has invested feelings is the one who has handed the knife handle to another, the one waiting to be slaughtered; wield this knife of feeling, and it can not only reap the multitude but poison countless others.

text: 13.男女关于追人，是截然相反的。
en: 13. When it comes to pursuing someone, men and women are the complete opposite.

text: 两个男人追一个女人，用情浅的那个先放弃；两个女人追一个男人，用情深的那个先放弃。
en: When two men pursue one woman, the one who cares less gives up first; when two women pursue one man, the one who cares more gives up first.
